snippet.title: Kaos Kards - Beta Release Trailer
snippet.description:
─── ✦ ── GAME DESC ── ✦ ───
Do you like strategy? Do you enjoy throwing bread at people? Well then this game is for you!
Take on five unique opponents in a fast-paced strategy card game where every turn is a mind game. 
Build your deck, manage your hand, and time your plays to gain the upper hand. 
Use Action Cards to attack, heal, or defend. Boost your odds with Dice Cards, or shake things up with unpredictable Kaos Cards that affect everyone on the field.

─── ✦ ── ITCH PAGE ── ✦ ───
https://zayzoon.itch.io/kaos-kards

─── ✦ ── CREDITS ── ✦ ───
